title: Stamp and Go Saltfish Fritters
description: Stamp and Go Saltfish Fritters is a dish from Jamaica featuring salt cod, all-purpose flour, chicken egg, green onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Salt cod must be fully desalinated under refrigeration with water changes before frying the fritters.

steps.instruction: Desalt the salt cod for roughly 24 hours in the refrigerator, changing the water several times, then drain; never leave soaking fish at room temperature.
Gently cook the prepared contents in the simmering liquid from earlier steps until fully cooked and safe to eat.
Flake the thoroughly cooked, desalted cod with a fork; remove every bone and keep the fish ready for the mixture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 14 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
